Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:示例应用 showcase 给三张外币发票(INV-1007 日元、INV-1009 和 INV-1010 欧元)各补一行发票明细;18.0 预发布数据库的恢复脚本在恢复时把活动日志分片改成“昨天”的日期。
- 为什么改:多币种测试项原先只有两张外币发票金额非零,其余三张只能看到汇率选择、看不到换算;恢复出来的活动日志分片日期停在 10 月 27 日,首次启动就被 7 天保留策略删掉,测试项读不到那 66 行。
- 风险与回滚:只动示例应用种子数据和测试夹具脚本,都不发布(两个包都是 private);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`examples/app-showcase/src/data/seed/index.ts` 新增的三行发票明细;`packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-harness/cli-prerelease-fixture.ts` 的 `restore`。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec tsx test/upgrade-harness/cli-prerelease-fixture.ts restore --to /tmp/x/n5.db`,预期多打印一行 `re-dated shard sys_activity__r20261027 → sys_activity__r<昨天>`。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。卡上另有三个待决问题(第 92、135、263 行,以及 90+153 合并的一问),见下文与报告评论。

## What changes

Two files, fixture space only.

1. **Row 220 · `records-forms.multi-currency-invoice`** (`examples/app-showcase/src/data/seed/index.ts`): one invoice line each under INV-1007 (JPY), INV-1009 (EUR) and INV-1010 (EUR), so all five foreign invoices carry a non-zero total and both rate rows of each currency are exercised. Measured on a stock boot of this head (a throwaway probe, deleted after the run):

   ```
   INV-1004 EUR amount=450    home=500     rate=0.9
   INV-1007 JPY amount=95400  home=629.7   rate=151.5
   INV-1008 JPY amount=237864 home=1593.73 rate=149.25
   INV-1009 EUR amount=2016   home=2191.3  rate=0.92
   INV-1010 EUR amount=276    home=300     rate=0.92
   ```

   Before this PR, INV-1007, INV-1009 and INV-1010 had no lines (amount 0), as the QA record measured.
2. **Row 209 · `cli-18-prerelease-db` restore** (`packages/qa/dogfood/test/upgrade-harness/cli-prerelease-fixture.ts`): `restore` now passes both dumps through the harness's own `fixture-as-of.ts` (`shardRenamesAsOf` + `renameShardTables`), so the restored telemetry sibling's `sys_activity` shard is dated the day before the run and the first boot's rotation retention keeps it. It prints each rename. Measured: at base `d3f3f4ab` the restore writes `sys_activity__r20261027`; at this head it writes `sys_activity__r20261113` (66 rows) on 2026-11-14. Neither `manifest.json` nor the recipe names the shard, so no census read changes.

## Per-row dispositions (all 16 section A rows, re-measured on `origin/main` `d3f3f4ab`)

| row | disposition | evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 80 | already done on main | `packages/services/service-storage/src/attachment-member-grant.ts` contributes read + create on `sys_attachment` to every member's baseline since `fd6374713` (2026-11-13 07:58Z); the QA run was at `ee9ad834` (03:17Z), which does not contain it (`merge-base --is-ancestor fd6374713 ee9ad834` exit 1; `fd6374713` in HEAD exit 0; control `ee9ad834` in HEAD exit 0) |
| 89 | out of scope (product) | app packages cannot author settings namespaces (spec migration `18.translation-per-app-settings-platform-only`), and no built-in manifest declares `scope: 'user'` (`packages/services/service-settings/src/manifests/*.ts`). A user-scope secret is a platform manifest change, not a fixture |
| 90 | needs_decision (with 153) | the item needs one item name held by two installed packages; no stock boot carries a second package, and the showcase is one app package |
| 91 | already runnable; item text owed | `identity-auth.self-signup-gate` knownGaps[0] records the env door (`OS_AUTH_AUDIENCE_POSTURE`, `OS_AUTH_AUDIENCE_ALLOWED_EMAIL_DOMAINS`, `OS_AUTH_AUDIENCE_SELF_REGISTRATION_PERMISSION_SET`) measured live; variants[1]/[2] still say blocked(fixture). `identity-auth.json` is held by batch A PR #33362, so the re-point is owed there |
| 92 | premise does not hold; not changed; needs_decision | `showcase_task.assignee` is `Field.text` and the showcase stores an EMAIL in it on purpose: the seed writes persona emails (`seed/index.ts` "#7746" block), the notify flows read it as a recipient, `invoice.owner` and `private_note.owner` follow the same email convention, and `search.json` / `records-forms.json` tell runners to assign by email. The QA run had PATCHed a user id into it by hand (record 6846028996: "the run had set assignee to a user id"). Switching the rule to ids would hide every seeded task from its assignee |
| 135 | needs_decision | Ada holding `showcase_finance` or `showcase_legal` also makes her a required approver of the seeded invoice dual sign-off (`showcase_invoice_signoff`, unanimous over finance + legal, `flows/index.ts`), so the stock demo changes beyond the quorum item |
| 151 | out of scope (product) | `mandatoryTopics` is reachable only as a `MessagingServicePlugin` constructor option (`packages/services/service-messaging/src/messaging-service-plugin.ts`); a declarative door is product work. Carrier: #33352 |
| 152 | environment-bound | the agent catalog is served only by the Cloud/Enterprise `@objectstack/service-ai`; `platform-core.keyboard-shortcut-surface` knownGaps[1] already scores that half blocked(environment). Belongs with section B |
| 153 | needs_decision (with 90) | measured: a second app (`active: false`) in the showcase is refused at build, "An 'app' package must define at most one app" (defineStack single-app validation, ADR-0019). The fixture needs a module package composed beside the showcase. Tried in `d2faa4b58`, withdrawn in the next commit |
| 155 | recipe text owed | the flow is runner-built from `studio-authoring.flow-edge-type-authoring` fixtures.requires[1] ("Start → Decision → two End nodes"); adding a loop is text in `studio-authoring.json`, held by batch B PR #33360 |
| 208 | held | `scripts/qa/qa-fixture.mjs walled-boot` is held by #33334 |
| 209 | **landed here** | see What changes 2. The recipe text in `cli.json` is routed to batch D (#33330) |
| 218 | out of scope (product) | stamping environment rows with a host package is hosted-runtime behaviour, not seed data. Carrier: #33352 |
| 220 | **landed here** | see What changes 1. The item text ("only INV-1004 and INV-1008") lives in `records-forms.json`, held by batch B PR #33360 |
| 227 | recipe text owed | there is no committed 18.3.0 fixture: the file is runner-built (`platform-core.activation-ledger-package-key-upgrade` route (a)/(b)). Planting a connector instance and an assignment rule is recipe text in `platform-core.json` / `cli.json`, held by batch D (#33330) |
| 263 | needs_decision | `records-forms.gantt-interactions`: the stock task gantt view declares no `lockField` / `dependenciesField`; either the showcase task gains them (plus a dependency field and seed), or the item keeps the documented overlay route and narrows |

Totals: 16 rows · 2 landed here (209, 220) · 2 already right (80, 91) · 4 needs_decision questions over 5 rows (92; 135; 90+153; 263) · 3 owed as recipe or item text in held area files (155, 227, plus the 91 and 220 text) · 1 held by #33334 (208) · 3 out of scope as product (89, 151, 218) · 1 environment-bound (152).

No `packages/**` outside `packages/qa`, no new door, no area file (every one this card would touch is held by an open batch PR or card: #33362, #33360, #33359, #33327, #33330), no RUNNER.md.

## Why

The v18.4.0 sweep parked 22 fixture rows (#32908 ledger `/mnt/project-files/pm-orders/devx/32908-ledger.md`, routed to #33351 by triage). Section A is the 16 rows that looked like seed or fixture additions. Each was re-measured on main here first; two are fixture additions that hold today and land in this PR, and the rest are answered row by row in the table above. Source records: #32908 comments 6844741021, 6846028996, 6846283471, 6850382730, 6850413952, 6850460138, 6850495479 and 6852480973.

## Acceptance notes

- Rows 90 and 153 want the same thing: a second package on the stock boot (one holding a name the showcase also holds; one carrying a switched-off app). One module package composed beside the showcase would serve both; that is a choice about the example's shape, so it is a question on the card, not a change here.
- Row 92's ruling rested on "`assignee` stores a user id". On main it stores an email by the showcase's own convention, so the rule was left as it is and the question goes back on the card.
